reviewedSince: Published v8.0.5 through the accepted seven-page sample on 2026-11-18.
sources: User requested clickable approval of the script, new character sheet, page and optional SNS post.
The user reported a stalled MCP connection and requested AI-managed re-pairing and reload.
The final page required visible floor contact, full-body walking composition and recurring character consistency.

findings.observation: Real job remained unclaimed after the browser pairing expired.
findings.rule: Read diagnostics, check the tab and job, re-pair in the same tab and reload only if necessary after safeguarding work.
findings.reason: Service health does not prove that a browser has claimed a job.

findings.observation: User wanted to accept a shown item with a mouse.
findings.rule: Show the item and offer clickable choices at creative transitions when supported.
findings.reason: An approval refers to the exact deliverable and next operation.

findings.observation: A revision changed the recurring character hair and an earlier composition hid the boots.
findings.rule: Compare revised panels against the adopted sheet, adjacent appearances and important body contact.
findings.reason: Image edits can affect surrounding details beyond the requested change.

checks.name: Skill validation and Windows synchronization tests
checks.evidence: SKILL.md validator and ten bootstrap, synchronization and package tests.

checks.name: Live MCP production and save on v8.0.5
checks.evidence: Original waiting job claimed after re-pairing. Final page completed through MCP and the matching PNG and JSON were approved and posted in order.
